[SWS_FrArTp_00227] ⌈The FrArTp shall reject the request for receive cancellation by
returning E_NOT_OK when
• the cancelled connection is not active, or when
• the FrArTp has already received the last frame of an unacknowledged connection,
or when
• the FrArTp has already provided the final AF of an acknowledged connection.
